Suncor Energy INC New (SU) Share Price Declined While Locust Wood Capital Advisers LLC Has Cut Position April 18, 2018 - By simple simple
Stephen J. Errico decreased its stake in Suncor Energy Inc New (SU) by 10.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Locust Wood Capital Advisers Llc sold 151,938 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.02% with the market. The hedge fund run by Stephen J. Errico held 1.29 million shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $47.49M, down from 1.45M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Locust Wood Capital Advisers Llc who had been investing in Suncor Energy Inc New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $60.24 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.95% or $0.36 during the last trading session, reaching $38.22. About 834,930 shares traded. Suncor Energy Inc. (NYSE:SU) has risen 13.82% since April 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.27% the S&P500.
Locust Wood Capital Advisers Llc, which manages about $781.63M and $1.08B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Howard Hughes Corp (NYSE:HHC) by 61,705 shares to 413,166 shares, valued at $54.24 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Vantiv Inc (NYSE:VNTV) by 256,220 shares in the quarter, for a total of 503,590 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
